headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts Back to Wardens; Mooring County Reopens
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has swung back toward the Wardens, who now hold six of its nine strategic posts against three, after a stretch in which Crow's Nest and Frostmarch saw near-constant exchange; casualties there remain the war's steepest, and fresh action was logged as this dispatch was filed. Mooring County is no longer a closed book, for the Colonials have taken one of the twelve posts the Wardens lately swept, with movement noted at The Wind Hills. Callahan's Passage stands where it did, eight Warden to two Colonial, yet its ledger is dreadful — nearly twenty-two thousand casualties added in a day — and The Crumbling Passage ranks among the war's busiest grounds. Fisherman's Row, so turbulent of late, has gone silent through the past two hours, its seven-to-two Colonial advantage intact. Stlican Shelf's four-five split holds while the fighting there cools markedly. Palantine Berm, quiet in our last report, has re-ignited about Leiri Hermanni, and the Nevish Line's fierce exchange has slackened. It is day 395; thirty-four victory towns will decide this war, and no victor is named.
